# LimeRoad Marketplace Canonical Pack — V4 Source-Grounded Semantic Curation

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: semantic_text.docx_grounded_v4
  status: resolved
  resolution: 'Semantic-heavy fields were rewritten from LimeRoad DOCX source facts: NSP model, COD base, OMS tax evidence,
    settlement row types, joins, mandatory filters, and data-quality caveats.'
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

Reusable LimeRoad marketplace semantic pack only. Runtime/client account cards, bank reconciliation, statutory filing, ERP mapping, and external logistics lifecycle cards are out of scope unless supplied by separate packs.

## 2. Validation Contract

Locked v17 full-spectrum validation: no warnings, no alias edge names, SQL blueprint checks, universal role-specific semantic profiles, deterministic edge coverage for structured references, and all edges scoped.

    - seller.trunkroute LimeRoad
    - LimeRoad India seller data
    business_meaning: Reusable LimeRoad/V-Mart marketplace identity for Indian seller commerce, OMS invoice, settlement,
      NSP payout, return, GST, TCS, and TDS semantics.
    business_questions:
    - Which marketplace identity anchors LimeRoad reusable semantic cards?
    - Which platform context should route LimeRoad India seller data?
    - What boundary prevents GSTIN, group_level_id, AWB, or bank-transfer mentions from becoming runtime account cards?
    semantic_tags:
    - limeroad_platform
    - v_mart_operator
    - docx_grounded
    included_concepts: []
    excluded_concepts: []
    caveats:
    - V-Mart operator facts are source context only, not tenant/runtime account cards.
    examples: []
  retrieval:
    node_sets:
    - card_type:platform
    - domain_family:marketplace
    - platform_id:platform.limeroad
    - applicable_source_role:settlement
    - card_role:platform
    - platform_alias:limeroad
    embedding_text: The LimeRoad platform represents the reusable V-Mart/LimeRoad marketplace identity behind the OMS
      and settlement data. It supports routing for LimeRoad seller orders, NSP-based payout, returns, GST, TCS, and TDS;
      it is not a tenant, bank, statutory filing, ERP, or external logistics connector. Apply the linked filters or value
      profiles before aggregation, and normalize row type or source direction where the report logic requires it.
    search_keywords:
    - LimeRoad
    - V-Mart
    - seller.trunkroute.com
    exact_match_keys:
    - platform.limeroad
  evidence:
    source_documents:
    - LimeRoad Recon KB.docx

    source_format: markdown_yaml_blocks
    evidence_refs:

    platform_type: marketplace

    - V-Mart LimeRoad
    - LimeRoad / V-Mart
    supported_contexts:

    source_platform_codes:
    - limeroad
    - trunkroute

    pattern_type: side_by_side_comparison

      domain_family: marketplace
      platform_context_ids:
      - platform_context.limeroad.in
      source_roles:
      - settlement
    required_tables:
    - table.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement
    optional_tables: []
    required_columns:
    - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.order_id
    - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.vendor_nsp
    - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.gross_commission_perc

    time_basis: settlement_date
    join_requirements: []
    aggregation_rules:
    - Validate settled_amount from vendor_nsp and commission rate
    output_contract_id: output_contract.limeroad.oms_settlement_reconciliation
    sql_pattern_ref: sql.limeroad.settlement.commission_validation
    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: query result at documented grouping grain
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: group_level_id
        required: true
        type: integer
        source: runtime_account_binding
        description: Client runtime account binding supplies the LimeRoad group scope value; reusable pack keeps it as
          a parameter.
      required_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement
      required_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.vendor_nsp
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.gross_commission_perc
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.settled_amount
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.entry_type
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.group_level_id
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.is_active
      template: "SELECT\n  order_id,\n  vendor_nsp,\n  settled_amount,\n  ROUND(vendor_nsp * (1 - gross_commission_perc\
        \ / 100), 2) AS expected_settled,\n  ABS(settled_amount - ROUND(vendor_nsp * (1 - gross_commission_perc / 100),\
        \ 2)) AS variance\nFROM zs_observe.limeroad_settlement\nWHERE is_active = true\n  AND group_level_id = :group_level_id\n\
        \  AND entry_type = 'ITEM_SALE'\n  AND vendor_nsp > 0\nORDER BY variance DESC\nLIMIT 20;"
      ctes: []
      joins: []
      filters:
      - expression: is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        source: runtime_account_binding
        required: true
      - expression: entry_type = 'ITEM_SALE'
        filter_type: business_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      - expression: vendor_nsp > 0
        filter_type: business_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      group_by: []
      having: []
      order_by: []
      output_columns:
      - name: settled_amount
        source: column
        canonical_id: null

    sql_pattern_ref: sql.limeroad.recon.oms_settlement_invoice_item
    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: query result at documented grouping grain
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: group_level_id

          a parameter.
      required_tables:

      required_columns:

      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_oms.charged_amount

      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.vendor_nsp

      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.entry_type
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.item_id
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.invoice_number
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.is_active
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.limeroad_settlement.group_level_id
      template: "SELECT\n  o.invoice_number,\n  o.order_id,\n  o.item_id,\n  o.charged_amount AS oms_invoice_value,\n\
        \  o.total_tax AS oms_tax,\n  s.charged_amount AS stl_charged,\n  s.vendor_nsp,\n  s.settled_amount,\n  s.entry_type,\n\
        \  ABS(o.charged_amount - s.charged_amount) AS price_variance,\n  CASE\n    WHEN s.item_id IS NULL THEN 'Not\
        \ in Settlement'\n    WHEN ABS(o.charged_amount - s.charged_amount) > 1 THEN 'Price Variance'\n    ELSE 'Matched'\n\
        \  END AS recon_status\nFROM zs_observe.limeroad_oms o\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.limeroad_settlement s\n  ON o.invoice_number\
        \ = s.invoice_number\n AND o.item_id = s.item_id\n AND s.is_active = true\nWHERE o.is_active = true\n  AND o.group_level_id\
        \ = :group_level_id\n  AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';"

        expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: true

      - stage: base_source_filter
        expression: transaction_type = 'forward'

        source: query_pattern

      operation_shape: record_level_join

      - stage: base_rows
        purpose: Filter LimeRoad source rows to active runtime scope before any aggregation, comparison, or netting.
        grain: source row before report aggregation

        join_key_normalization: Use documented invoice_number plus item_id relationship for OMS-settlement joins; use

          rows before netting or ratio calculations.

      - name: reverse_deductions
